title: Backpack Adoption Analyze executor
description: Analyzes this NX project's JSX/TSX files for Backpack adoption and writes a per-project result file.

pattern.description: Glob (relative to the project root) for files to scan.

threshold.description: Backpack adoption percentage threshold for this project.

dryRun.description: Report regressions as warnings instead of failures.

outputPath.description: Where to write this project's adoption result JSON, relative to the project root.

baseWorktreePath.description: Absolute path to a checkout of the PR base ref (workspace root), if PR comparison is desired. When omitted, only head is reported.
